meta.name: 四级高频词 100 词
meta.source: 内容官 A 校对台 · 已校对 100/100

words.example: They had to abandon the plan because of the storm.
words.exampleZh: 由于暴风雨，他们不得不放弃这个计划。

words.example: She has the ability to solve difficult problems.
words.exampleZh: 她有解决难题的能力。

words.example: He worked hard to achieve his goal.
words.exampleZh: 他努力工作以实现目标。

words.example: We visited an ancient temple in the mountains.
words.exampleZh: 我们参观了山中的一座古庙。

words.example: The annual meeting will be held in May.
words.exampleZh: 年度会议将在五月举行。

words.example: We need a new approach to this problem.
words.exampleZh: 我们需要一种新方法来解决这个问题。

words.example: Tickets are still available at the box office.
words.exampleZh: 售票处仍有票可售。

words.example: Regular exercise will benefit your health.
words.exampleZh: 经常锻炼对你的健康有益。

words.example: She is capable of handling the project alone.
words.exampleZh: 她有能力独自处理这个项目。

words.example: Learning a language is a real challenge.
words.exampleZh: 学一门语言是真正的挑战。

words.example: The new library serves the whole community.
words.exampleZh: 新图书馆服务于整个社区。

words.example: I can't concentrate with all this noise.
words.exampleZh: 这么吵我无法集中注意力。

words.example: She feels confident about the interview.
words.exampleZh: 她对面试很有信心。

words.example: Please consider my suggestion carefully.
words.exampleZh: 请仔细考虑我的建议。

words.example: Chinese culture has a long history.
words.exampleZh: 中国文化历史悠久。

words.example: They decided to move to another city.
words.exampleZh: 他们决定搬到另一个城市。

words.example: The company plans to develop a new app.
words.exampleZh: 公司计划开发一款新应用。

words.example: Success comes from constant effort.
words.exampleZh: 成功来自持续的努力。

words.example: We should protect the environment.
words.exampleZh: 我们应该保护环境。

words.example: She has ten years of teaching experience.
words.exampleZh: 她有十年教学经验。

words.example: His voice sounded familiar to me.
words.exampleZh: 他的声音听起来很熟悉。

words.example: The younger generation loves online shopping.
words.exampleZh: 年轻一代喜爱网购。

words.example: Reading every day will improve your writing.
words.exampleZh: 每天阅读会提高你的写作。

words.example: Parents have a great influence on children.
words.exampleZh: 父母对孩子有很大影响。

words.example: Knowledge is power.
words.exampleZh: 知识就是力量。

words.example: She manages a team of twenty people.
words.exampleZh: 她管理着一个二十人的团队。

words.example: This job is a great opportunity for you.
words.exampleZh: 这份工作对你是很好的机会。

words.example: He never talks about his personal life.
words.exampleZh: 他从不谈自己的私生活。

words.example: It is possible to finish the work today.
words.exampleZh: 今天完成这项工作是可能的。

words.example: We must prepare for the exam.
words.exampleZh: 我们必须为考试做准备。

words.example: The school provides free lunch for students.
words.exampleZh: 学校为学生提供免费午餐。

words.example: What is the reason for your absence?
words.exampleZh: 你缺席的原因是什么？

words.example: We should reduce the use of plastic.
words.exampleZh: 我们应该减少塑料的使用。

words.example: My family always supports my choices.
words.exampleZh: 我的家人总是支持我的选择。

words.example: It is a tradition to eat dumplings at Spring Festival.
words.exampleZh: 春节吃饺子是一种传统。

words.example: The report gives an accurate description of the event.
words.exampleZh: 这份报告对事件做了准确的描述。

words.example: Children adapt to new environments quickly.
words.exampleZh: 孩子们能很快适应新环境。

words.example: I can't afford such an expensive car.
words.exampleZh: 我买不起这么贵的车。

words.example: I really appreciate your help.
words.exampleZh: 我非常感激你的帮助。

words.example: Don't assume that everyone agrees with you.
words.exampleZh: 不要假定每个人都同意你。

words.example: A positive attitude helps you go further.
words.exampleZh: 积极的态度能帮你走得更远。

words.example: Are you aware of the risks involved?
words.exampleZh: 你意识到其中的风险了吗？

words.example: Ten teams will compete for the prize.
words.exampleZh: 十支队伍将争夺这个奖项。

words.example: This is a complex issue with no easy answer.
words.exampleZh: 这是一个没有简单答案的复杂问题。

words.example: Everyone contributed to the success of the event.
words.exampleZh: 每个人都为活动的成功做出了贡献。

words.example: She convinced me to change my mind.
words.exampleZh: 她说服我改变了主意。

words.example: The government declared a state of emergency.
words.exampleZh: 政府宣布进入紧急状态。

words.example: The demand for clean energy is growing.
words.exampleZh: 对清洁能源的需求在增长。

words.example: You need to pay a deposit before moving in.
words.exampleZh: 入住前你需要交押金。

words.example: You deserve a rest after all that work.
words.exampleZh: 做了那么多工作，你应该休息一下。

words.example: Can you distinguish between the two twins?
words.exampleZh: 你能区分这对双胞胎吗？

words.example: The new system is much more efficient.
words.exampleZh: 新系统效率高得多。

words.example: The teacher emphasized the importance of practice.
words.exampleZh: 老师强调了练习的重要性。

words.example: Water is essential to all living things.
words.exampleZh: 水对所有生物都是必不可少的。

words.example: Experts estimate the cost at one million dollars.
words.exampleZh: 专家估计成本为一百万美元。

words.example: We guarantee the quality of our products.
words.exampleZh: 我们保证产品的质量。

words.example: He ignored my advice and failed.
words.exampleZh: 他忽视我的建议，结果失败了。

words.example: Her speech impressed everyone in the room.
words.exampleZh: 她的演讲给屋里每个人留下深刻印象。

words.example: The results indicate a clear improvement.
words.exampleZh: 结果表明有明显的进步。

words.example: It is important to maintain a healthy diet.
words.exampleZh: 保持健康饮食很重要。

words.example: You must obtain permission before entering.
words.exampleZh: 进入前你必须获得许可。

words.example: All students are encouraged to participate.
words.exampleZh: 鼓励所有学生参加。

words.example: He persuaded her to try again.
words.exampleZh: 他说服她再试一次。

words.example: The young player has great potential.
words.exampleZh: 这位年轻球员潜力巨大。

words.example: I didn't recognize him with a beard.
words.exampleZh: 他留了胡子，我没认出他。

words.example: The survey reflects public opinion.
words.exampleZh: 这项调查反映了公众意见。

words.example: She was reluctant to leave her hometown.
words.exampleZh: 她不情愿离开家乡。

words.example: We have sufficient food for a week.
words.exampleZh: 我们有够吃一周的食物。

words.example: She accomplished the task ahead of schedule.
words.exampleZh: 她提前完成了任务。

words.example: The room is adequate for two people.
words.exampleZh: 这个房间供两人住是够的。

words.example: We anticipate a rise in prices.
words.exampleZh: 我们预计价格会上涨。

words.example: The decision seemed completely arbitrary.
words.exampleZh: 这个决定看起来完全是武断的。

words.example: Teachers assess students' progress each term.
words.exampleZh: 老师每学期评估学生的进步。

words.example: The book offers a comprehensive overview of history.
words.exampleZh: 这本书提供了对历史的全面概览。

words.example: His story is consistent with the facts.
words.exampleZh: 他的说法与事实一致。

words.example: She studies contemporary art in college.
words.exampleZh: 她在大学学习当代艺术。

words.example: This is a crucial moment for the team.
words.exampleZh: 这对球队来说是关键时刻。

words.example: The damage was clearly deliberate.
words.exampleZh: 这一损坏显然是故意的。

words.example: His influence has diminished over the years.
words.exampleZh: 多年来他的影响力已经减弱。

words.example: Could you elaborate on your plan?
words.exampleZh: 你能详细说明一下你的计划吗？

words.example: They live in an enormous house in the countryside.
words.exampleZh: 他们住在乡下一栋巨大的房子里。

words.example: Don't exaggerate; it wasn't that serious.
words.exampleZh: 别夸张，没那么严重。

words.example: She gave explicit instructions for the task.
words.exampleZh: 她为这项任务给出了明确的指示。

words.example: Prices fluctuate with market demand.
words.exampleZh: 价格随市场需求波动。

words.example: Reading is a fundamental skill in education.
words.exampleZh: 阅读是教育中的一项基本技能。

words.example: The data support the original hypothesis.
words.exampleZh: 数据支持最初的假设。

words.example: The school decided to implement a new policy.
words.exampleZh: 学校决定实施一项新政策。

words.example: Change is inevitable in any organization.
words.exampleZh: 在任何组织中，变革都是不可避免的。

words.example: How do you interpret this sentence?
words.exampleZh: 你怎么解释这句话？

words.example: Nothing can justify such behavior.
words.exampleZh: 没有什么能为这种行为辩护。

words.example: He has a legitimate reason for being late.
words.exampleZh: 他迟到有正当理由。

words.example: The two companies are negotiating a contract.
words.exampleZh: 两家公司正在协商一份合同。

words.example: The meaning of the poem is rather obscure.
words.exampleZh: 这首诗的含义相当晦涩。

words.example: Online shopping is a worldwide phenomenon.
words.exampleZh: 网购是一种世界性现象。

words.example: Please give me the precise time of arrival.
words.exampleZh: 请告诉我确切的到达时间。

words.example: We should preserve the old buildings in the city.
words.exampleZh: 我们应该保护城市里的老建筑。

words.example: He agreed with great reluctance.
words.exampleZh: 他非常勉强地同意了。

words.example: The two events happened simultaneously.
words.exampleZh: 两件事同时发生。

words.example: We need sustainable solutions for the future.
words.exampleZh: 我们需要面向未来的可持续方案。

words.example: Young children are vulnerable to infections.
words.exampleZh: 幼儿容易受感染。
